### Problem

#634 (the board may comment on a pull request, #633) is merged and not in a version. Until v7 carries it, the required `waiting / What waits on whom` job fails with HTTP 403 in every repository but this one, so no same-repository pull request can merge anywhere in the organisation. The release lane cannot make this release yet (dilux-bot has no Commit statuses permission), so this one is made by hand.

### Scope

- Rebuild CHANGELOG.md with v7.13.1 (`scripts/changelog.py build --next v7.13.1`); a patch: two fixes (#630, #634), nothing breaking for the callers.
- Before moving `v7`, `scripts/caller-contract.py check` passes; tag v7.13.1 on the merge commit, move v7 to it (lightweight), and watch the adopted repositories for runs that end in `startup_failure` for 30 minutes.

### Out of scope

- The release lane's missing permission.

### Acceptance criteria

- C1: Given the release pull request merged, when v7.13.1 is tagged, then v7 points at it, its GitHub Release lists #630 and #634, the `waiting` job passes on the organisation's open pull requests, and no adopted repository's run ends in `startup_failure` in the next 30 minutes.

### Criticality

Critical
